lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.purpose: GPS snapshot v3 includes continuous reason duration and observer/sleep gaps; reception/acquisition/filter waits stay local and sustained delivery faults retain correlated outcomes. SDK cache under private files/diagnostic-reports is partitioned by DSN and bounded to 256 ordinary envelopes; contract 3 retains supplied data under size limits. Expected local tile GET 503 resource guards stay in MapRuntime logs, unknown/remote failures retain first-report throttling. Native scope keeps operation/phase; historical failures may receive same-process/type/timestamp OS exit metadata in the reserved context budget. Retry never refilters cached replay or fatal events; no new user setting.
